Dashboards: Shiny packages

Source: vignettes/dashboard-extensions.Rmd
dashboard-extensions.Rmd

Many packages extend Shiny with page layouts, inputs, outputs, notifications or javascript tools. This page lists the ones rvis dashboards support today, the ones they can use without changes, and the ones that could be supported by new item types, with what that would take.

Supported packages

Package Supported through
shiny all standard inputs and outputs, fluidPage, sidebarLayout, navbarPage, navbarMenu, tabsetPanel, navlistPanel, tabPanel, conditionalPanel, wellPanel, column, plot interactions, download buttons
shinydashboard dashboardPage (header style), sidebarMenu, menuItem, menuSubItem, tabItems, tabItem, box, value and info boxes (outputs and clothes)
shinyBS bsModal, bsCollapse, bsCollapsePanel, tooltips and popovers of any item
shinyWidgets actionBttn, actionGroupButtons, airDatepickerInput, plot spinners
shinyjs methods hideItems(), showItems(), enableItems(), disableItems(); any shinyjs function in services
rintrojs guided tours: tutor.lesson of any item, tutorBox
DT dataTableOutput with DataTables options
bcrypt encrypted passwords of the login table
htmlwidgets 23 output types: highcharter, plotly, dygraphs, leaflet, rAmCharts, billboarder, c3, morrisjs, d3plus, bubbles, networkD3, sankeytreeR, wordcloud2, sunburstR, upsetjs, rpivotTable, rhandsontable, googleVis, rCharts and the widgets embedded in rvis (TFD3, coffeewheel); any other htmlwidget as a package::fooOutput item; clicks on chart items as inputs (click.events); see the item reference

Packages usable without changes

These packages work in configurations as they are: their functions are called in services, the prescript, observers, !expr values or static items.

Package How
shinythemes theme: !expr shinythemes::shinytheme("flatly") of a navbarPage, fluidPage or sidebarLayout; theme selector as a static item object: !expr shinythemes::themeSelector()
bslib theme: !expr bslib::bs_theme(bootswatch = "minty") of a page
shiny notifications, modal dialogs, progress showNotification(), showModal(modalDialog(...)), withProgress() in services (gallery)
shinyalert, sweetalert of shinyWidgets shinyalert::shinyalert(...), shinyWidgets::sendSweetAlert(session, ...) in services
markdown object: !expr shiny::includeMarkdown("about.md") in a static item
any htmlwidget a dynamicInput whose service returns the widget (rendered by renderUI()), or htmlOutput
any input function a dynamicInput returning the input (its value is input$<id>) or a static item object: !expr pkg::someInput("id", ...)

Packages that could be supported

These need new item types in dashboard.R: the input or output function in getItemObject() or outputObject(), the render function in outputScript(), and their names in valid.input.types, valid.output.types or valid.container.types.

Package Items Effort Notes
shinyWidgets pickerInput, switchInput, materialSwitch, prettyCheckbox, prettyRadioButtons, radioGroupButtons, checkboxGroupButtons, sliderTextInput, noUiSliderInput, knobInput, searchInput, dropdownButton, progressBar small inputs with the same choices/selected settings as shiny inputs; the most useful next step
bslib page_sidebar, page_navbar, card, value_box, layout_columns, accordion medium modern Bootstrap 5 pages and cards; containers like box and dashboardPage
bs4Dash dashboardPage (Bootstrap 4), bs4Card, bs4ValueBox, tabItems medium similar to shinydashboard, with more box options
shinydashboardPlus box options (sidebar, dropdown), user boxes, right sidebar small extends the current shinydashboard items
waiter, shinycssloaders spinner setting for all outputs small the current spinner only applies to plotOutput
reactable reactableOutput small interactive tables
timevis timevisOutput small timelines
sortable rank_list, bucket_list inputs small drag and drop ordering (instead of sortableR)
shinyFiles shinyFilesButton, shinyDirButton medium server-side file selection; needs shinyFileChoose() in the server (could be generated)
colourpicker colourInput small colour input
shinyAce aceEditor small code editor input
shinyFeedback, shinyvalidate validate rules of inputs medium input validation messages from the configuration
shinymanager secure login for the whole app medium an alternative to the login item
cicerone guided tours small an alternative to rintrojs
shiny.i18n translated titles medium titles could be translation keys
shinyjqui draggable, resizable, sortable settings of any item small jQuery UI interactions, like tooltips are added to any item
shiny.semantic Fomantic UI pages and inputs large a different css framework: a parallel set of item types
rhandsontable editable table synced with sync small the output is supported; syncing edits like TFD3 tables would need observers

The example files of the user

The shiny_examples folder of the rvis repository has examples of Shiny packages. This is how they map to rvis dashboards:

Example rvis dashboard
bscollapse_example.R, bsmodal_example.R, tooltip_example.R, popover_example.R supported: bsCollapse, bsModal, tooltip, popover (example)
gettablemodal_example.R supported: build.container.get.table() returns the items of a dialog reading a CSV table
rintrojs_example_1.R to _3.R supported: tutor.lesson, tutorBox (example)
modalDialog.R, showNotification.R, progressbar.R usable in services (modal dialog, progress)
shinythemes.R, themeSelector.R usable: theme: !expr shinythemes::shinytheme(...), static theme selector (example)
scrollable_panel.R supported: box cloth with height and style: "overflow-y: scroll"
shinywidgets_examples.R partly supported (actionBttn, actionGroupButtons, airDatepickerInput, spinners); more shinyWidgets inputs are candidates (see above)
shinyFiles_example.R candidate (server-side file choosers)
sortableR_examples.R candidate, with package sortable (sortableR is no longer maintained)
shinySky_example.R not recommended: package shinysky is no longer maintained; its inputs exist in shinyWidgets
links.R (reference links) next/previous buttons: updateItem4Session() on a navbarPage, navlistPanel or sidebarMenu (a tabsetPanel has no id yet); shinyjs and shinyWidgets: see above; semi-collapsible sidebar: shinydashboard sidebars collapse with the header button; shinyjqui and shiny.semantic: candidates (see above)
